server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Shown in the Valheim browser and in the invite text you share with friends.

world_name.title: World Save Name
world_name.description: Loads an existing world with this name, or creates it if no matching world exists.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Passed to the dedicated server launch command. New instances receive a unique password that can be shared with invited players.

public_server.title: Browser Visibility
public_server.description: Controls whether the dedicated server announces itself publicly or stays private or direct-share only.

crossplay_enabled.title: Enable Crossplay
crossplay_enabled.description: Uses Valheim's crossplay backend so Steam and non-Steam players can join through the same room.

instance_id.title: PlayFab Instance ID
instance_id.description: Use a unique value for each server sharing the same port and MAC address so PlayFab assigns distinct server IDs.

save_interval_seconds.title: Auto Save Interval (Seconds)
save_interval_seconds.description: How often the dedicated server writes the live world state to disk.

backup_count.title: Backup Count
backup_count.description: How many rolling Valheim-native backup generations the server keeps.

backup_short_seconds.title: First Backup Interval (Seconds)
backup_short_seconds.description: Interval for the first automatic backup. Subsequent backups use the long interval.

backup_long_seconds.title: Subsequent Backup Interval (Seconds)
backup_long_seconds.description: Interval between automatic backups after the first backup.

world_preset.title: World Preset
world_preset.description: Apply a preset at startup, replacing saved world modifiers. Leave empty to preserve the current world rules.

world_modifiers.title: World Modifiers
world_modifiers.description: One modifier and value per line, for example combat hard or resources most. Applied after the selected preset.

world_set_keys.title: World Keys
world_set_keys.description: One world key per line: nobuildcost, playerevents, passivemobs, or nomap.

admin_list.title: Admin Platform IDs
admin_list.description: One platform ID per line. LanGame renders adminlist.txt and copies it into the active Valheim save root on launch.

banned_list.title: Banned Platform IDs
banned_list.description: One platform ID per line. LanGame renders bannedlist.txt and syncs it into the live Valheim save directory.

permitted_list.title: Permitted Platform IDs
permitted_list.description: One platform ID per line. LanGame renders permittedlist.txt and syncs it into the live Valheim save directory for the dedicated server to read.

custom_launch_flags.title: Advanced: Custom Launch Flags
custom_launch_flags.description: Additional Valheim launch flags appended to the launch plan.

log_file.title: Log File Path
log_file.description: Optional server log destination. Leave empty to use LanGame managed logs only.
